description: This PHP file defines a Maintenance controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class manages the display of a maintenance page, setting appropriate HTTP headers and rendering a view with maintenance message and navigation breadcrumbs.

classes.name: Maintenance
classes.description: Controller class handling the maintenance mode page, rendering it with proper headers and content.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the maintenance page, setting HTTP headers, preparing data including breadcrumbs and messages, and rendering the view.
